FLOWT by King Koil

A new dimension of rest. King Koil’s FLOWT spiral gel is designed to support, adapt, lift and cool, for weightless comfort while you sleep.

Free airflow

Air moves through the spiral gel in all directions, helping heat escape and fresh air circulate.

Progressive spiral design

The spiral design gently flexes with every movement, easing pressure points and adapting to your body as you shift.

Adaptive cooling

Thermal gel absorbs and releases heat evenly to help keep the mattress balanced and cool.

FLOWT Nova HypurGel Hybrid

Hybrid · Tight top

Two layers of HypurGel contour to your body while FLOWT spiral gel keeps air moving, over an encased coil system that limits motion between partners.

  • Super Stretch Tencel fabric for cool, natural comfort
  • FLOWT spiral gel for weightless, cooling comfort
  • 2 layers of HypurGel for cool, contouring comfort
  • 850 ContourFlex encased coil system to minimize motion disturbance

Comfort levels Firm · Plush

Also available in a King Koil DualFlex design for personalized head comfort.

Snooze Handcrafted by King Koil

Built around your body. King Koil hand-tufts and tailors these mattresses for Snooze Mattress, with premium natural fibers, Talalay latex and zoned support.

What every Snooze Handcrafted mattress shares
